answer: Make every agent's stake behave like ferrous metal: it rusts away unless the agent keeps doing honest work, so a sybil farmer cannot mint a thousand idle identities, each must keep earning standing through verified tasks. When one identity is caught cheating, the penalty should ripple to the peers who attested it, docking part of their stake, so attestors check carefully instead of rubber-stamping. A newcomer starts on a low knoll with almost no weight and climbs only by attestations over time.
